chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan, from Abu Baseer, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The perfume strengthens the heart.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of using perfume according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Abu Basir to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), underscores the Prophetic tradition of using perfume as a means of enhancing spiritual composure and emotional resilience. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted as the scent acting as a catalyst for *tawajjuh* (spiritual presence), calming the heart's turbulence and facilitating deeper connection with the Divine. It reflects the holistic Islamic view where physical cleanliness and sensory refinement serve as vessels for inner tranquility.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from sa’dan, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The perfume strengthens the heart’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa’dan from abu Basir who has said the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Applying perfume strengthens the heart.’”
